title: Reservoir observation-role and likelihood preflight
forbidden_inputs: the four spatial extrapolation station observations
classification_rule: Station names alone never establish total reservoir release. A station may be a general downstream-flow likelihood, an immediate-downstream candidate requiring semantic confirmation, a component/diversion station, or excluded/ambiguous.
purpose: Determine whether formal R1/R2 fitting and the reservoir-specific release gate have enough legally classified development observations.
